svg.title: Live view: a member asks Xiaoran about snacks; she searches the chat history first, then replies twice

g.text: I'm bringing the new Catan expansion
I'll bring chips and dried fruit, no chili strips since Joe
and a box of the matcha cookies Kit wanted
Mia wants snack ideas. People said
what they like before, so check the chat.
Joe · Oct 26: I don't eat anything spicy
Kit · Oct 26: matcha cookies for me
Joe can't do spicy and Kit asked for
I'll bring chips and dried fruit, no chili…
and a box of the matcha cookies Kit…
